**Finding**

1. **[P2] The 401 replay test can pass without proving refreshed credentials or a valid response stream.**  
   [refresh-capable.test.ts:570](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/test/refresh-capable.test.ts:570) only checks that two HTTP requests occurred. Because the returned stream is lazy and never consumed, malformed SSE or reuse of the rejected access token would still pass.

   **Remediation:** capture both authorization headers, assert the second uses the refreshed token, consume the returned stream, and assert the terminal completion chunk plus `[DONE]`.

No other actionable pass-3 defects were found. Header and idle timeouts use Effect’s per-pull semantics, cancellation reaches upstream finalizers, SSE sequencing and limits fail closed, duplicate indexes are rejected, proxy ingress/auth are bounded, and Photon diagnostics exclude provider-controlled strings.

Repository checks are green, but no hosted or provider behavior was exercised by this pass.
